title: Mrs. Michal Tawil: Connecting to God Through Our Personal Relationships (class #42)

chapters.title: Introduction and memory of her mother-in-law
Processing pain and looking beneath the surface
chapters.about: Surface world, spiritual world, infinite values

chapters.title: Connecting to parents' values
chapters.about: DNA, eternal values, Holocaust survivor story

chapters.title: The journey to a lev tov
chapters.about: Lag BaOmer, Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, Zohar

chapters.title: Applying the lev tov in relationships

summary: Mrs. Tawil discusses how to move beyond the surface level of daily life and personal relationships to connect with the eternal values, or Torah, beneath our experiences. She explains that by asking deep questions rather than reacting with criticism, we can uncover the spiritual essence in our interactions with others and our parents. This process of internalizing values is presented as a way to prepare for receiving the Torah on Shabuot.
questions: How can I stop my emotions from controlling me when I feel pain?
How do I find the eternal value behind a person's actions instead of just criticizing them?
What is the best way to handle disagreements with a spouse regarding household or parenting decisions?
How can I connect to the values of my parents after they have passed away?
How does the journey from Pesach to Shabuot help us develop a good heart?
